# `validation_failed`

**Type:** `https://docs.anywaye.com/errors/validation_failed`

**HTTP status:** `422`

**Title:** `Validation failed`

A reserved code. The status is fixed at 422 by the contract, so a client that sees this code can act on the status without reading further.

## Example

```json
{
  "type": "https://docs.anywaye.com/errors/validation_failed",
  "title": "Validation failed",
  "status": 422,
  "detail": "email is not a deliverable address",
  "instance": "/v1/example",
  "code": "validation_failed",
  "trace_id": "0af7651916cd43dd8448eb211c80319c",
  "errors": [
    {
      "field": "email",
      "code": "invalid_format"
    }
  ]
}
```

## Stability

Contract infrastructure — this URI is permanent. PLAN §1 stability rule 2 / DECISIONS.md MD30 exempts `docs.anywaye.com/errors/<code>` from every docs redesign and path rewrite: a client may store this URI and dereference it years later. The only permitted change is the addition of a new `<code>`.
